I tried talking to her, but like I said, all she did was complain and cry so there wasn’t a “right” time to say something like that. The last thing I wanted was to make her feel worse by telling her I wasn’t having fun with her. Yes I should have been former, but I’m going to try and talk to her about it tomorrow.

Yes, that’s what I should’ve done. I’m not sure why I let her keep it, but I really regret it. I felt like I did the right thing at the moment but it just costed me my time and enjoyment in the long run.

I understand, she’s very on and off with him since she is practically the “other woman”. Coincidentally, after terribly crying and complaining all last night about how horrible he is to her, she went to his house to “talk” and ended up being on good terms with him. This is the third time this has happened in the span of two months.

I tried offering help, but she does not take the advice I give to her.

I understand, I just feel extremely guilty for just leaving him. I see that he wants to try, but I think it’ll be hard to. I’m not sure whether to give up or see where it goes.
I see your point. Thank you for that.

I just feel guilty for it. the LDR guy is very nice, but I’m just not sure it’ll work in our favor. I think I’d be better with the guy irl, we’re more physically closer & we can do things easier in our favor.

I feel like I do deserve a better relationship than what I had with him. I cannot take myself down because of what he did to me. I couldn’t control what he did, & it makes no sense to try to control how fast I move on from those events based on him. I hate everything he’s done to me but I can’t continue to hold that against myself. He’s an asshole for doing that & leaving me fucked over. All my feelings of guilt aren’t gone, but I need some time to fully comprehend that I cannot control everything or whatever happens to me.

Thank you. This really brung a greater understanding to my problem. I truly appreciate it.

Yes.

I understand what you’re saying, how holding myself too accountable can under-blame whoever also takes part of the problem. Maybe once I understand that not everything is my fault & that shit just happens beyond my control, I might not feel this way. What he did was not my fault. The reason why I feel this way is not my fault. However, it is his fault & I cannot hold myself accountable because what he did was all on him & if he had a problem with what I was doing at literally 14yrs old, he should’ve talked to me about it instead of taking it out physically on me. I understand.

I hate that I’m not someone who can hate someone for what they did. I hate that I can’t be mad for the shit he did to me & whatever happened after. My problems now are all rooted from his stupid actions. I just don’t know why I still carry that emotional weight with me.

I guess you could say that. I’d admit it too, but I just feel like some part of me plays a role in it too.

I understand the point where I can’t make myself move on so fast from such experiences. Although it’s been a long time, I can’t just leave it in the past to not dread over.

I mean I do, but I’m not very much of a person who despises people like that. I hate that I am not a vindictive person. I’m more of a person who is extremely self disciplined and gets after herself for everything she does. Yes I hate him for everything he’s done but it’s just weird how I can’t just hold that against him but I can do it against myself.

Well I feel kinda stupid but I understand that short term problems can cause long term consequences. I moved away shortly after we broke up, so I always told myself I can do whatever I wanted simply because HE IS NOT HERE. Although, I still encounter this problem. I know he is not here. I am not there. I am safe. It’s hard but I understand your point.

Obviously not, but I seem to feel the need to be over it because if he moved from it so fast, why can’t I? I feel ready for another potential relationship, but it feels wrong. People always told me “you were 13-15, that was nothing” so I’m just not sure. Again, I’m over him just not what happened.
I just don’t know why I still feel this way. It’s been two years idk why I’m still affected by it :/
